title: Comparative radar chart
intent: Compare representative USA and GBR decathlon results across four normalized events.

ai.create: Create a comparative radar chart by folding and normalizing the full decathlon population, then filtering USA and GBR and selecting the first row per country and event.
ai.maintain: Update either profile while preserving authored metric direction, event order, first-row country selection, stable country-event identity, the fixed zero-to-one radial domain, and shared guide geometry.
